verdict.rationale: Relay docs mention 'automate approvals' and 'define roles' for teammates, and pricing page lists 'Multi-step approval rules' as a feature, supporting configurable approval permissions for payments. However, there's no detailed documentation on the one-click approve/send UX for designated approvers, and community reviews note some users experienced 'issues with permissions,' suggesting occasional friction. Missing for 10: explicit description of one-click approve/send workflow, detailed permission granularity (e.g., approval thresholds per teammate), and hands-on confirmation the feature works smoothly.
